content: GitHub Pages custom domain apex DNS HTTPS certificate provisioning delays CNAME pitfalls: custom domains require CNAME pointing to username.github.io, apex domains need DNS provider that supports ALIAS or similar. HTTPS certificate provisioning can take 24-48 hours after CNAME setup. Pitfalls include DNS propagation delays, misconfigured CNAME records, and certificate provisioning failures. For zhangtaolab.org with baseurl '', ensure proper CNAME setup and allow time for certificate provisioning.
